title: Wanderers
body:
flash the lights
fluttered see
you’re not real please
talk to me

go there, share it
they don’t know
what to miss and
where to go

hands apart but
would you take mine
right to left
somewhere, sometime

title: Made by Humans
body:
kill the grass
build taller, taller
choking nature
thinking smaller

don’t just lie there
see it coming
we will die there
bodies summing

don’t look past
don’t think too far
first ones first
leave footprint-scar

we were made here
didn’t like it?
own agenda,
refuse to fight it

ending; ended
sorry soil

title: untitled
body:
surely take me
hill to hill
call the lights;
dim the sights
turn me down
and break it

looking over
street and damp
taking cover
goes to sadness;
goes to coldness
go to sleep

waiting here
for you and I,
all the times
to pass me by

introspect
and don’t detect
all the errors,
change yourself-
remove it all or
undersell

time for time!
no more for still
the clock is mean
but knows you will

title: Our doing; Our undoing
body:
let’s go walking
take me there
through lushest trees and
rubbish air

look, can’t see
try counting them
all the while
amounting them

to all the other
living things
sorry this is
what we bring

will we choose
to die or live
poison raindrops
might forgive?

title: All for Most?
body:
somewhere in the
   city-light
ants are screaming
eyes not seeing
thoughts provoke and
minds deceiving

somewhere in the
   city-light
beetles cry and
humans fight
so much thinking
time unblinking
into endless night

title: Never More
body:
all the friends
I never knew
tell me something:
what to do?

Earth is lost and
life is gone
were we ever
in the wrong?

warships, starships
always seeking
humanity’s breath
was far too fleeting

dream of stars and
paint the sky
those are dead who
cannot cry

title: It’s fine.
body:
sometimes, sometimes
keep me happy
share their tears and
see me helping

pass up, pass up
catch me crying
come to feel the
feelings dying

title: Relationship: Reflection I
body:
growth & growing
always showing
talk to wall with
thoughts foregoing

would you see me
am I here?
being hurt with
love to fear?

show more
no more
take me out
friends forgive
might lovers shout?

falling petal
drying flower
all too real in
worst time-hour

title: Relationship: Reflection II
body:
somewhere in the
inside there
more to give and
care to share

see me not;
don’t look dead-on
off the rails crash
all too strong

help me up- no,
gone am I
left better for
self timely-try

title: untitled
body:
sometimes in the fire-light
darkest smog is burning bright
   crushed-up papers,
   off-thrown takers
teach me how to kill the fight
